title: Sathuranga Vettai
desc: A cunning fraudster profits from deceiving numerous victims. However, trouble ensues when a criminal group seeks revenge against his betrayal.

title: Trigger
desc: An amateur set designer visits a dense forest to erect a set for an upcoming movie. However, he realises his mistake when he is informed of the growing tiger attacks in the forest.

desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

desc: Selva's move to Chennai for work leads to unexpected involvement in crime. As the city falls into disarray, a dishonest politician manoeuvres for control.

desc: Chandran lies to his boss in order to go and watch a football match, but his boss also attends the match and catches him. Later, to save his job, Chandran is forced to lie about having a twin brother.

title: Nedunchalai
desc: Murugan steals groceries from passing trucks in order to make a living. However, things take a turn when he comes across Masani, a corrupt and perverted inspector.

desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Por
desc: Amidst political rivalry and caste discrimination brewing in their college, Yuva, a junior, and Prabhu, a senior, find themselves at loggerheads with each other.

desc: An undercover police inspector investigates a mysterious abduction case of the daughter of the director general of police of a state which bears similarity with the description of a crime novelist.

desc: Gemini said When a woman and her friends reach a small town, they uncover a link to a ghost and realise their grandfather left behind a secret legacy that changes their lives forever.

title: Bhanumathi
desc: Varun, an NRI medical student, and Bhanu, a vivacious, young woman, fall in love with each other. However, they face many personal differences that create complications in their relationship.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoominathan, a NASA scientist, helps his village people against the evil corporations.
